spans.s: ताप m. heat, ardour, pain, affliction.
तपःक्लम a. exhausted by austerities.
तपःक्षम a. fit to bear austerities.
तपती f. N. of a daughter of the Sun & of a river.

त॑पन a. warming, burning, shining (of the sun);
 vexing,
tormenting. m. the sun, a cert. hot hell. f. तपनी॑ heat, ardour. n.
तपन॑ the same + pain, penance, religious austerity.

तपनीय m. a sort of rice;
 n. (purified) gold.
तपनीयाशोक m. a kind of Acoka.*
तपश्चरण n. ˚श्चर्या f. the practice of penance.
तपस्य् त॑पस्यति do penance.
तापस्य n. the state or condition of an ascetic.

त॑पस्वन्त् a. glowing;
 ascetic, devout.
तपस्विकन्या f. ˚जन m. a female devotee.
तपस्विजन m. = seq. m. (also coll.).
तपात्यय m. the end of the heat, the rainy season.
तपान्त m. the end of the heat, the rainy season.
त॑पिष्ठ (superl.) very hot or burning.
तपिष्णु a. burning, glowing, hot.
त॑पु a. burning, hot.

त॑पुषि a. the same;
 m. or f. a burning weapon.
तपुष्पा॑ a. drinking hot (drinks).
त॑पुस् a. = त॑पु.

तपोनिधि m. a treasure of penance, i.e. a very pious
man.
तपोऽन्त a. ending with austerity.

तपोभृत् a. bearing penance, ascetic;
 m. = prec.
तपोमध्य a. having austerity in the middle.
तपोमूल a. founded on austerity.
तपोयज्ञ a. having austerity as sacrifice.

तपोयुक्त a. devout, religious (lit. furnished with
penance).
तपोयोग m. practice of austerities.
तपोरत a. delighting in penance.
तपो˚रति a. delighting in penance.
तपोलुब्ध a. eager for penance, devout.
तपोवन n. penance grove, hermitage.
तपोवन्त् a. ascetic, devout, pious.

तपोवृद्ध a. strong by or rich in penance, very devout
or religious.
तप्तकृच्छ्र m. n. a kind of penance.
तप्तायस् n. red-hot iron.
तप्ति f. heat, warmth.
तप्यति॑ f. heat, warmth.
तप्तृ a. making hot or warm.

तप्यतु॑ a. hot, glowing;
 f. = तप्ति.
तापक a. heating, burning, purifying.

तापनीयोपनिषद् f. T. of sev. Upaniṣads (cf.
prec.).
तापयिष्णु॑ a. burning, tormenting.
तापश्चित॑ n. a kind of ceremony ((r.)).

तापस॑ a. performing penance or belonging to it. m. a
devotee, ascetic, hermit (f. ई).
तापसवेषभृत् a. wearing a hermit's clothes.
तापिच्छ m. N. of a plant.
तापिञ्छ m. N. of a plant.

तापिन् a. vexing (—˚);
 f. ˚नी T. of sev. Upaniṣads.
ताप्य m. n. marcasite.
